title: BOB Etihad Guest Premium credit card

cardOverview.overviewText: The Etihad Guest Premium Credit Card is a premium co-branded travel card built for frequent flyers who want faster mile accumulation and elite travel perks with Etihad Guest. It offers a generous welcome miles bonus, complimentary Etihad Guest Gold Tier.
